core_principles: Cinematic and Rugged: Use dark moody lighting and high-contrast layouts.
Godly Dark Luxury: Minimalist aesthetic relying on deep blacks, sharp typography, and subtle metallic/olive accents.
Tactical Precision: Sharp edges, dense information hierarchy where needed, structured grid layouts.
design_philosophy.vibe: Forged for the Fearless - intimidating yet highly premium, like a fusion of high-end fashion and military gear.
anti_patterns: No generic soft shadows or rounded bubbles.
Avoid pure white backgrounds; use off-white only if absolutely necessary for contrast in specific elements.
Do not use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings.

rules: Headings must be uppercase to convey military strength and tactical presence.
Use JetBrains Mono for specs, stock counts, and technical details.

grid_strategy.product_grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-1 sm:gap-4

surface_strategies.navigation: Crystal Glass - backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 border-b border-white/10
surface_strategies.product_cards: Flat solid background with sharp 1px border on hover, dark gray fill.
surface_strategies.buttons: Solid white background with black text for primary, transparent with 1px border for secondary. Hover state uses #1A1A1A or Olive.
surface_strategies.badges: Military Khaki or Gold for 'Limited Edition' and 'Bestseller'. Sharp edges.

components_specifications.hero: Cinematic full-screen with dark overlay (bg-black/50), featuring bold typography centered or left-aligned. Call to action in stark white.
components_specifications.product_card: No internal padding for images. Image takes 80% height, details below. Hover swaps image to secondary lifestyle shot.
components_specifications.sliding_cart: Dark sidebar (bg-[#0A0A0A]) with stark borders, clear typography for checkout totals, and a fixed bottom CTA.
components_specifications.marquee: Use for 'LIMITED DROP' or 'XIII KARGIL'. Low contrast text (dark grey on black) slowly panning in background, or high contrast small text for announcements.
components_specifications.checkout: Multi-step accordion style, clear input borders, strict data validation, military-style summary receipt.
components_specifications.pdp_gallery: Left side sticky gallery or grid of massive HD images. Right side sticky details.
components_specifications.countdown_timer: Monospaced font (JetBrains Mono) with stark dividers for drops.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Images subtly scale up (scale-105) over 0.5s ease-out. Buttons inverse colors instantly.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in smoothly, content slides up slightly (20px).
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Parallax effect on hero and collection background images.

hero.description: Dark moody streetwear model, sitting on concrete bench (use for hero or main collection)

collections.description: Woman in black hoodie (use for hoodies collection)
Tactical cargo pants detail (use for bottoms/cargo collection)

products.description: Urban tactical streetwear pose (use for product lifestyle)
Man in black and red hoodie (product shot)
Casual streetwear young man outdoors (product lifestyle)

backgrounds.description: Dark leather texture (use for section backgrounds or dark premium overlays)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not inject bright colors outside of the defined accents.
Ensure the application is mobile-first, paying special attention to the sticky navigation and sliding cart.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide React for crisp, professional iconography.
Implement the 'Bento Grid' for the Collections Showcase (XIII Kargil, Bravest of the Brave, etc.).
All interactive elements must include data-testid for testing.
Ensure high-contrast ratios for all typography over images; use gradient overlays (black/70 to transparent) where needed.
Buttons should have zero border-radius for the rugged tactical feel.
